snippet.title: Tremble of Towers TRAILER
snippet.description:
Prepare for Action in Tremble of Towers!

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496330/Tremble_of_Towers/

Get ready to defend your golden vein in Tremble of Towers, a unique take on the Tower defense genre with cooperative gameplay for up to 4 players! Work together to fend off waves of unique enemies ranging from carts and planes to massive, moving fortresses, all while exploring an ever-changing, auto-generated world.

What makes Tremble of Towers unique from other tower defense games is the ability to build any structure with any resource; ice freezes, magma burns, lead increases range, wood increases critical damage, etc... combine these resources with any structure you want to give it the traits that you desire. For example: build an Arc Turret (A turret that fires bullets that travel up to 4 nearby enemies) with the ice mineral, and you get an Icy Arc Turret; capable of slowing 4 enemies at once!

countless of other clever combinations of structures are waiting for you to be made...
